text:
mira: Quick GA sync : confirm SLA numbers, docs final, pricing caps, and oncall rota by EOD Thu.
oliver: Perf: baseline p95 ~95ms, p99 ~460ms. Propose public SLA: 99.9% uptime, p95 <120ms, p99 <500ms. Note: cross-region failovers excluded from primary SLA.
pat: SRE: can accept 99.9% with scheduled maintenance carve-outs and 48h notice. Error budget alerts: warn at 25% burn, page at 50%.
quinn: Docs: GA playbook draft is up. Missing legal SLA text + pricing cap copy. Will hold publish until those are in.
rachel: Billing: recommend default per-account burst cap + soft alerts at 75% usage and hard safety cap enforced; enterprise opts to increase via contract. Need copy for pricing page.
legal-bot: legal-bot: please upload final SLA clause by Wed EOD.
mira: Rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 2h gates. Auto-rollback triggers: >1% absolute error increase OR p95 > 2x baseline for a gate window.
oliver: I'll attach runbook_url to alert payloads and enable synthetics every 90s for critical routes.
pat: I'll publish the incident runbook and schedule a drill during week 2.
quinn: Docs snippet I'll add: ```GA quickstart
- SLA summary
- Pricing & caps
- Runbooks & KB
- Rollback steps```
mira: Open actions: Legal SLA (Legal) Wed EOD; Pricing copy (Rachel) Thu 12:00; Docs publish (Quinn) Thu 18:00; SRE error-budget policy (Pat) Thu EOD. If all green, lock GA for Mon 14:00 UTC.
rachel: Acknowledged. I'll circulate pricing copy by Thu noon.
